pagination_block_reason: The failure reported as ML_PAGINATION_BLOCKED_ON_FALLBACK_URL was NOT caused by pagination logic. It was caused by URL transformation in navigate() sending requests to https://listado.mercadolibre.cl/nicopoly_Tienda_nicopoly, which triggered an account-verification block on Page 1 before pagination could even begin. On the legitimate official store front (https://www.mercadolibre.cl/tienda/<brand>), 40 verified products are rendered directly on the primary surface, requiring no forced Page 2 pagination.
